_comment: Drop-day site watcher. mode:'status' watches a SITE's state, not a product: it alerts when the site flips into maintenance (classic sign a drop is being loaded in), when the queue/waiting room goes up (URGENT alert — pair with listener.mjs to auto-open the page so you join the queue immediately), and when it comes back to normal. Checks every ~60s, which is fine for a couple of watches on drop days — don't add dozens at this cadence. Run alongside your normal config in its own terminal: node checker.mjs --config queuewatch.json

watches.name: Pokémon Center — hyped product page
watches._note: Optional: on a drop day, point this at the specific product/category page for the release — queues sometimes go up per-page rather than site-wide.
